title: Negros Oriental eyes Korean solar, battery tech for energy resiliency

blocks.text: DUMAGUETE CITY, Negros Oriental, Philippines — Negros Oriental is looking to strengthen its power supply and reduce dependence on conventional electricity sources through a proposed renewable energy and battery storage project with South Korean companies. The initiative, formalized through the signing of a memorandum of agreement and letter of intent on Saturday, Nov. 21, seeks to integrate solar power generation with large-scale sodium-ion battery energy storage systems to help address power interruptions, voltage fluctuations, and the province’s growing electricity requirements.
